statement: You are given an array heights of non-negative integers describing a histogram: bar i has width 1 and height heights[i], and the bars stand side by side.
A rectangle inside the histogram covers a run of consecutive bars, and its height can be at most the shortest bar in that run.
Return the area of the largest such rectangle.

examples.explanation: The bars of height 5 and 6 together support a rectangle of height 5 and width 2, with area 10.
Either the bar of height 4 alone or both bars at height 2 gives area 4.
